title: SG-10.2.4 Keyboard focus moves write to the store focus
summary: Keyboard focus moves in BootScene write focusedObjectId to the game store so the store owns focus state
description: Context: BootScene.onKeyDown (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) moves focus with moveFocus and only emits the focusChange event on phaserToReact. The store already has focusedObjectId and setFocusedObject, and applyFocusedObject already pushes store focus into the scene. Desired behavior: Tab, Shift+Tab and arrow keys write the newly focused id to the store via setFocusedObject. Expected result: the store is the single owner of focus state. Why: avoids duplicated focus ownership between Phaser and React.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene with a focusable object, when Tab is pressed, then useGameStore.getState().focusedObjectId equals the id of the object now focused.
Given focus moves with Shift+Tab or an arrow key, when the handler runs, then the store focusedObjectId equals the newly focused id.
Given no object is focused after a move, when the handler runs, then the store focusedObjectId is null.
Given a keyboard focus move, when the store is written, then applyFocusedObject leaves the scene focus unchanged and does not blur the focused object.

preserve: focusChange and menuClose events still emitted

technical_constraints: Reuse useGameStore.setFocusedObject; do not add store fields
definition_of_done: Keyboard focus moves update the store focusedObjectId
Existing keyboard and focus tests still pass
